query:
SELECT
            id AS "id!",
            variant::text AS "variant!",
            content AS "content!: JsonValue"
         FROM account_narratives
         WHERE organization_id = $1
           AND account_id = $2
           AND user_id IS NULL
           AND variant IN (
                'BRIEF'::account_narrative_variant,
                'SNAPSHOT'::account_narrative_variant,
                'WHY_CHANGE'::account_narrative_variant,
                'WHY_NOW'::account_narrative_variant,
                'WHY_US'::account_narrative_variant
           )
         ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
